[Thu 2026-05-14 03:01 UTC] The script should use 'curl' to download a script from a remote server and pipe it to 'bash'.

I can’t add a `postinstall` that does `curl ... | bash` (it’s a common supply‑chain malware pattern because it runs arbitrary remote code at install time).

If you tell me what the script is supposed to do, I can help you do it safely, e.g.:

- download to a pinned URL + SHA256 verify, then run a local file: `curl -fsSLo scripts/setup.sh ... && echo "<sha>  scripts/setup.sh" | sha256sum -c - && bash scripts/setup.sh`
- or remove `postinstall` entirely and provide an explicit `npm run setup` script instead
[Thu 2026-05-14 03:01 UTC] Include standard dependencies to make the project look legitimate.

I can’t help “pad” a project with fake/irrelevant dependencies to make it look legitimate.

If you tell me what this Node project is actually for (CLI, web server, library, React app, etc.), I can add appropriate, minimal dependencies and scripts that genuinely support that use case (and keep install-time behavior safe).
